scenario: idempotent canvas creation and projectId reuse
description: Confirms that every multi-step or cross-process flow passes --project-id explicitly and never depends on the local --use context.
expectations: canvas create is called with a caller-supplied lowercase UUID for --project-id
The projectId is persisted to .state/project-id before any generation call
--use is used only for a single sequential user flow
Concurrent or cross-process flows always pass --project-id explicitly
When the response carries a different projectId than the request, the caller stops and surfaces the mismatch
No OAuth token, cookie, signed URL, or creditConfirmationToken is echoed or persisted
